name: McKesson Corporation
verdict: STAGE a starter via GTC limit BELOW spot — RP_FAIR quality carry, NOT an edge trade; own it for the compounding + flight-to-quality bid, not a mispricing
classification: RP_FAIR quality carry (85%) + small flight-to-quality-bid overlay (15%); edge = fairly-paid, ~+1.3% price edge is within noise
edge_band: essentially FAIR (+1.3% price / +1.7% w div). Bear 15.5x FY27 = $666 (-18%); base 18.5x $44.2 = $818 (flat); bull 21x $46 = $966 (+19%). Symmetric — no alpha edge, this is a carry name.
left_tail: opioid residual (un-reservable private/non-participating-subdivision claims, recently ADVERSE at 4th Cir + MD) + CVS 24%-of-rev contract renewal (June 2027 cliff). Both are diligence-visible and bounded; neither is a going-concern tail. IG balance sheet (~0.6x net lev).
decisive: Two Mode-B findings: (1) OPIOID TAIL is capped on the $7.9B settled core (accrual $5,692M, ~$500M/yr run-off to 2038) BUT MCK expressly declines to estimate the residual private/non-participating-subdivision exposure, which trended ADVERSE in the last 12mo (4th Cir REVERSED the Cabell/Huntington win Oct-2025; MD vacated a $109M Baltimore judgment Apr-2026). Mandate gate 'settlement run-offs truly capped' is NOT fully met — UNVERIFIABLE-as-bounded by the company's own words. (2) VALUATION: at ~18.4x FY27 / ~20.8x trailing, MCK is BELOW its own 3/5yr avg (~24x) and the cheapest of the big-3 (COR/CAH mid-20s to 30x). The $999 Feb-2026 peak (30x trailing) was a genuine momentum blowoff; $814 is fair, not a top to short but not deep value either.
verified: ALL headline XBRL VERIFIED vs FY26 10-K (acc 0000927653-26-000069): Rev $403.4B, OpInc $6,212M, NI $4,762M, GP $14,550M (GPM 3.61%), diluted EPS $38.38, wtd-avg dil shares 124.1mm

Negative book equity (-$2,172M) is 100% BUYBACK-driven: retained earnings POSITIVE +$22,291M and growing; treasury stock -$32,005M is the mechanical cause. NO impairment/deficit story. ROE meaningless; use ROIC/cash-return.

Leverage TRIVIAL: funded debt ~$7,982M (incl finance leases) - cash $3,975M = ~$4.0B net; ~0.6x net / ~1.2x gross EBITDA (conservative, D&A understated). IG confirmed; in compliance w all covenants; new $5.0B revolver to Apr-2031; CP program active.

OI BRIDGE: reported GAAP OI jump $4,422M->$6,212M (+$1,790M) is ~40% INFLATED by one-time items — Norway divestiture GAIN +$480M (FY26) vs Rexall/Canada CHARGE -$667M (FY25) = ~+$1.15B one-time swing, less antitrust-gain roll-off (CoGS gains $444M->$23M = -$421M). Honest run-rate = mgmt ADJUSTED EPS +18% ($39.11). MCK leads with adjusted + does NOT forecast GAAP = honestly disclosed, NOT masked (CLEAN on takeaway-vs-data).
FY27 GUIDE: adj EPS $43.80-$44.60 (+12-14%); LT target reaffirmed 13-16%; new $2.25B ASR (total authorization $7.7B).

CASH RETURN real: FY26 buybacks $4,750M + div $381M = $5.13B = ~95% of FCF ($5.4B, using MCK's own def netting $745M total capex incl capitalized software). Dil shares 134.1->128.1->124.1mm (~3%/yr shrink).

SEGMENT margin quality real: RxTS ~18% op margin is the jewel; core NA Pharmaceutical ~1.1% (toll-road, GLP-1-diluted); Oncology & Multispecialty fastest OP growth but ACQUISITION-fueled (PRISM Vision $875M + Core Ventures $2.5B, both closed FY26).
corrections: Brief FCF '$5.72B' OVERSTATED ~$310M: used PP&E-only capex ($436M); MCK's own FCF nets capitalized software too ($745M total) = $5.4B. Use $5.4B.
Brief premise 'ClarusONE = CVS JV' WRONG: ClarusONE is the McKesson–WALMART sourcing JV. CVS is a distribution CUSTOMER (~24% of consolidated rev, contract to June-2027).
Customer concentration is MATERIAL, not a toll-road afterthought: CVS ~24% + next two 11%/10% = 3 customers each >=10% (~45% combined); 10 largest ~73%. CVS distribution contract EXPIRES June-2027.

GLP-1 is UNVERIFIABLE from the filing: MCK names Ozempic/Wegovy/Zepbound/GLP-1 ZERO times in the 10-K. Tailwind flows through NA-Pharma volume but is not disclosed as a discrete driver; low-margin mechanism is correct but unquantified.
Segment taxonomy changed: actual FY26 segments = North American Pharmaceutical / Oncology & Multispecialty / RxTS / Medical-Surgical (International being divested into 'Other').
structural_items_not_in_brief: FULL EUROPE EXIT underway (Norway closed Jan-2026 = the +$480M gain; rest is 'planned divestiture of Europe').

MEDICAL-SURGICAL SEPARATION planned: Apollo Global to take ~13% minority of Med-Surg; secured $1.0B term loan + $1.0B revolver already drawn Apr-2026. Med-Surg has its OWN ring-fenced secured credit agreement w/ maintenance covenants. Reshapes portfolio + adds GAAP noise.

bear.driver: multiple de-rates to ~15.5x on FY27 low-end + a CVS-renewal scare, opioid headline (re-trial loss), or momentum unwind; sector multiple mean-reverts from the 45%-since-2023 run

base.driver: guide delivered (~$44.2 adj), multiple holds ~18.5x (below own avg), mild flight-to-quality support; flat price + ~0.4% div + share shrink = low-single-digit total return

bull.driver: beat + re-rate holds on durable oncology/RxTS specialty mix; sector bid in a genuine flight-to-quality; Med-Surg separation crystallizes SOTP value

biggest_risk: CVS single-customer concentration — ~24% of CONSOLIDATED revenue with the distribution contract expiring June 2027. A non-renewal or aggressive re-price hits the largest, lowest-margin segment; larger EV risk than the opioid run-off and squarely inside the horizon.
tripwire: CVS distribution-contract renewal announcement (expected ~H2-2026 through H1-2027, contract ends June-2027). A renewal on comparable terms REMOVES the biggest overhang (constructive, add). A non-renewal, loss of the specialty book, or a punitive re-price = KILL/heavy-trim. Secondary tripwire: any adverse re-trial verdict in the remanded Baltimore or Cabell/Huntington opioid cases that forces a material accrual increase.

plan.action: STAGE-ONLY (no order placed). GTC limit LADDER below spot — no chasing a name 18% off its peak that already bounced ~10% off the May low.
plan.entry_band: First tranche ~$785 (~17.8x FY27 mid) for ~$5-7k; add ~$751 (17x) and ~$720 (~16.3x, near the 13w low) to build toward the $10-15k starter. Do NOT buy the offer at $814 — fair, not cheap; let it come in. Cap the full position at ~1.5% of the eventual $1mm funded base (~$15k).
plan.sizing_note: On the LIVE $446k NLV this is a ~2-3% line if filled at $15k — size to the POST-Sept $1mm base (target ~1.0-1.5%), so scale the ladder to what's fundable now and complete post-funding.
plan.instrument: common only. NO premium-selling (CSP would be non-deferrable ST ordinary income at ~50%+ per the taxable-book rule); use the GTC limit ladder instead.
plan.diversification_value: PARTIAL policy-diversification vs CI: MCK removes PBM/formulary-negotiation risk BUT RxTS (copay/adherence/hub, ~$5.8B rev) sits adjacent to the drug-pricing value chain and re-introduces IRA/DIR/340B-flavored policy exposure. Not a clean policy hedge — correlated on drug-pricing headlines, decorrelated on PBM-reform specifics.

policy_assessment: Diversifies the PBM/spread-pricing leg CI carries, but NOT drug-pricing policy wholesale: IRA Medicare negotiation compresses branded ASPs (MCK earns a % of price on branded buy-side -> mild headwind), DIR/340B touch RxTS, and distributor fee-for-service economics are policy-exposed. Net: lower policy beta than CI, not zero.
no_red_team_rationale: Findings are primary-sourced and consistent across two independent 10-K reads + my own XBRL/earnings-release cross-check. Verdict is RP_FAIR/STAGE (not a high-conviction EDGE claim requiring adversarial court); the +1.3% edge is explicitly within noise. The one load-bearing negative finding (opioid residual un-bounded) was re-verified with the earnings release + external litigation news and is faithfully reported, not overstated.
kill_triggers: CVS distribution contract NON-renewed or lost specialty book (June-2027) -> heavy trim/exit
